edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mint recipient inside mintAlto.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient inside mintAltoCap.
withdrawAlto sends ETH to msg.sender, allowing a malicious caller contract to reenter.
msg.sender is the direct beneficiary of the low-level ETH transfer in withdrawAlto.
mintAlto relies on block.timestamp to decide price era transitions.
random() derives its output from block.timestamp, making it miner-influenceable.
The constructor seeds safPriceTimestamp with block.timestamp, anchoring the price schedule to miner-controllable time.
mintAlto mints through _safeMint, which calls onERC721Received on a contract recipient before completing state updates.
mintAltoCap mints through _safeMint, exposing the same external callback surface.
giveaway mints through _safeMint to an arbitrary address.
airdrop mints repeatedly through _safeMint inside a loop.
restore force-mints through _safeMint to an arbitrary wallet.
withdrawAlto performs native ETH transfers to msg.sender and to an owner address.
increaseMaxSupply performs an unchecked uint256 addition on maxSupply.
The unchecked addition result is written into the maxSupply state variable.
airdrop calls backToCommunity to pick each mint recipient.
withdrawAlto calls backToCommunity to pick the secondary transfer recipient.
backToCommunity derives its index from random().
A malicious recipient contract can re-enter mintAlto from onERC721Received before supply accounting settles.
The recipient fallback can re-enter withdrawAlto while the balance has not yet been fully drained.
